description: Use when someone asks whether they may use a provider or send personal data to another country (cloud, hosting, CRM, US services). Whether sending personal data to a country is allowed without further safeguards under the Swiss FADP and under the EU GDPR (adequacy lists), by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. The lists change: check them before relying on the answer.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US, DE, JP.

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.

name: transfer_check
title: Transfer of personal data abroad
